graph.title: Naida's Gondola & the Goblin Thief
notes: Not a real problem: the booklet genuinely builds two separate models, the gondola (steps 1-13) and the rock/catapult scene with the goblin (steps 1-15). They are never joined, so the two groups stay disconnected on purpose.

Not a real problem: the trans-blue bowl tile b31 is placed in Naida's hand (page 2). Her minifigure parts (hair, head, torso, legs) are not in the inventory list, so they are not nodes. With no figure node, the bowl has no part to join, and I did not invent a connection to the boat. It stays a lone node, which is the third group.
Earlier fix kept: the goblin b62 rests on the rock scene (contact with b38), and the second purple-on-lime flower pair b59/b61 rests on the round lime tile b43, as in the final picture on page 30.
Several attachment positions (which exact pieces b5/b6, b7, b8, b9-b16, b26, b27, b28 sit on) are read from small isometric pictures and are approximate; ports left null where unclear.
The basket b28's clip is attached to the stern wedge b12 as an assumption; the manual picture does not show a distinct bar.
Technic joins: tile pin b42 into the connector axle-hole; red axle b53 through connector and catapult pin-hole; magenta leaves attached to the connector's pin (assumption).
Goblin tile b63 is held by the goblin (contact edge only).
